_about: A slot is one generative step of world building. Each is filled by a ComfyUI workflow in API format whose nodes are titled for it: 'IN:<name>' on a LoadImage takes an input image, 'IN:<name>.<field>' sets that input of that node (text, seed, denoise …; several nodes may share a name), 'OUT:<name>' on a save node (SaveImage, SaveGLB …) is an output. Any workflow titled this way can fill a slot — these files, a template from the agent's library, or a new one.

depth.about: Depth for a new world: a 16-bit map, bright = near, the size of the picture.

depth_da2_16bit.about: Depth Anything V2 Large, kept in float (local).

depth_sharp_metric.about: Apple SHARP metric depth, inverted and resized (local). Sharper edges; 'focal_length_mm' is the 35 mm-equivalent lens.

segment.about: Masks of what a prompt names in a picture.

inputs.prompt: what to find; 'label:N' = up to N instances
inputs.individual: one mask per instance (true) or one for all (false)

image_to_3d.about: A mesh from a picture of one object on a plain background.

i23d_hunyuan21.about: Hunyuan3D 2.1, shape only; textured from the picture afterwards (local, ~1 min).

i23d_meshy.about: Meshy image-to-3D with PBR textures, remeshed to 30k triangles (API, costs credits, ~2-4 min).

texture_refine.about: A patch of the picture made into a clean, detailed, tileable texture (img2img).

texture_refine_zimage.about: Z-Image Turbo img2img, seamless sampling (local, ~10 s).

texture_generate.about: A tileable texture from words alone.

material.about: PBR maps from a tileable colour texture; the maps tile too.

sky.about: A 2:1 equirectangular sky panorama that wraps sideways.

sky_zimage_pano.about: Z-Image Turbo 2:1, sampled to wrap sideways (local). Not a true equirectangular projection; fine for skies.

sky_qwen360.about: Qwen-Image 2512 with the 360 LoRA: true equirectangular (local).

object_image.about: A picture of one object from words, on a clean background, with its mask — for image_to_3d.
